explanation: Beethoven was 20 when Mozart died, so they were alive at the same time for about 21 years. As a teenager he even travelled to Vienna, possibly hoping to study with Mozart.

claims.text: Ludwig van Beethoven was born in December 1770.
Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart died in December 1791.
Beethoven was 20 years old when Mozart died, so their lives overlapped by about 21 years.
As a teenager, Beethoven travelled to Vienna, possibly hoping to study with Mozart.

Volatility: evergreen; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: both composers are known worldwide. Style: Oxford spelling, straight quotes, no en or em dashes, explanation within 35 words. Myths: screened against myths.json, no hit. Mystery: not applicable to a practice item. Whether he met Mozart on the 1787 trip is unproven, so c4 says 'possibly hoping'.
